The cat's small paws are raised to cover its eyes in a bashful or defensive posture. Bold black Traditional Chinese text is displayed at the top. (2) Multiple green rectangular objects resembling banknotes or paper currency begin to fall from the top of the frame, fluttering and landing on the cat's back. The cat remains stationary with its paws still shielding its face as the items accumulate. (3) The cat suddenly changes its facial expression, opening its mouth wide in an exaggerated gasp of joy or surprise. Its eyes remain closed in a squinting smile. More green banknotes rapidly rain down, creating a dense layer of paper around the character. (4) The final scene shows the cat sitting comfortably with a satisfied, smiling expression. Its eyes are closed and its paws are tucked in. The floor around it is completely covered in scattered green banknotes, indicating a wealth of currency.
